_comment: What Mission Control's Español report (Reports > Español) shows for La Habana: each scored
Puerta's point, the Spanish prompt, the two sentences and the right one. Copied from the story
page; the story never reads this file (Presentar en clase reads it for the right answer). Every
Puerta is one sentence pick, so each has one blank with key null. Each option's index is the
choice event's choiceIndex (the page shuffles the order it shows, but reports this order). The
fork is never scored. scripts/check-modules.js fails the build if a scored Puerta has no entry here.
focus: Ser vs. estar: origin, location, and the adjectives that change meaning (rica, aburrido)

puertas.label: ser for where you are from
puertas.prompt: Doña Caridad: “¡Bienvenidos, mis niños! ¿De dónde son?”

options.text: Soy de Georgia. Kate es de Inglaterra.
Estoy de Georgia. Kate está de Inglaterra.

puertas.label: está rica (tasty) vs. es rica (rich)
puertas.ask: You want to say the food is delicious.

puertas.label: estar for where something is
puertas.prompt: Yoel: “¡Mira! Una tarjeta de wifi. Dos dólares, dos horas.”
puertas.ask: Ask Yoel where the wifi is.

puertas.label: está aburrido (bored) vs. es aburrido (boring)
puertas.prompt: Kate: “What's up with Yoel? He hasn't said a word. Tell me in Spanish, I want to practice!”
